pg039_n0014.context: This is one alphabetic label from a textbook list or diagram. Say only the English name of the letter i: pronounced "eye". Do not pronounce it as a Swahili letter name. Do not read brackets or add Kipengele, Herufi, a number, an introduction, or any other words. This is a letter label, not a Roman numeral.
